study type: Secondary analysis of retrospectively collected data
outcome: Area under the curve (AUC) of MAP below 90% of baseline
cohort: Normotensive patients undergoing elective cesarean delivery at a tertiary care institution
finding: Using the individual pre-spinal MAP baseline, rather than earlier readings, resulted in similar AUC for patients with and without nausea, suggesting it may be the optimal baseline for guiding hypotension management during spinal anesthesia for cesarean delivery.
